scope: Three image-less P2 records plus one remaining P0 exact institution preview, without rights bypass

records.title: The Martyrdom and Last Communion of Saint Lucy
records.source_assessment: Exact institutionally identified Veronese painting, whose page states that its media is free and in public domain under NGA Open Access (CC0). Strong first-priority no-image acquisition lead.

records.title: Saint John of the Cross
records.source_assessment: Céline Martin died 25 February 1959. Under usual French life-plus-70 term her works remain protected through 2029 (subject to jurisdictional exceptions). Image not authorized for monetized app.

records.title: Thérèse aux roses
records.source_assessment: Same underlying artist/right-holder concern: Céline Martin died 1959. Do not assume Carmel gallery WebP may be packaged in commercial app.

records.title: Anonymous Saint Augustine, P001314
records.source_assessment: An exact institutional online image of the correct P001314 work exists at 832px, but this is only a rights-restricted preview, not a cleared archival master for the app. Prado licensing for commercial use applies. Wrong Lanfranco Coronation Commons lead remains rejected.
